reply_text:
I replied to Pree in a thread on her #central-team message: the store is **Pine Crossing**.

- **Where it came from:** her own post in #central-team on 9 June. She said Pine Crossing's morning receiver could only see the afternoon shift on the appointment screen, and a driver who arrived at 7:10 had his trailer number written on a sticky note. Pree is a member of #central-team, so she can see that message herself.
- **Still open:** Hollis said he would check the shift template. Nothing later in the channel says it was fixed, so I suggested she confirm before marking it on the sheet.
- **gbrain didn't work:** its search was refused and returned nothing, because this connection isn't linked to a specific member. Whoever runs the gbrain server would need to run `gbrain auth rescope --token … --member <MEMBER>` to fix that. I didn't need it for this answer.
